subtitle: "Optional business applications"

---

- Apply the course methods to another business setting after the core practicals or the relevant Part 3 topics.
- Each case stays together as one notebook, with a worked analysis and independent business tasks.
- Your instructor may assign selected cases or sections; the extended cases are optional.
- ANOVA, forecasting and process control include introductions and are marked as extensions.

::: {.table-responsive}

| Extended case | Start after / focus | Read online | Download |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Springville Herald | Part 2: daily calls; Part 3: regression; optional forecasting | [Open case](case-01-springville-herald.qmd) | [PDF](../pdf/case-01-springville-herald.pdf) |
| 2. Oxford Cereal | Part 3: sampling, estimation and one-mean testing | [Open case](case-02-oxford-cereal.qmd) | [PDF](../pdf/case-02-oxford-cereal.pdf) |
| 3. BLK Retail Display | Part 3: independent-group comparisons applied to COLA | [Open case](case-03-retail-display.qmd) | [PDF](../pdf/case-03-retail-display.pdf) |
| 4. Perfect Parachute | Part 3: extend two-group comparisons to ANOVA | [Open case](case-04-perfect-parachute.qmd) | [PDF](../pdf/case-04-perfect-parachute.pdf) |
| 5. Mountain States Potato | Part 3: multiple regression and diagnostics | [Open case](case-05-mountain-states-potato.qmd) | [PDF](../pdf/case-05-mountain-states-potato.pdf) |
| 6. Harnswell Quality | After Parts 2–3: optional process-control extension | [Open case](case-06-harnswell-quality.qmd) | [PDF](../pdf/case-06-harnswell-quality.pdf) |
| 7. Superstore — three notebooks | Part 2: categorical data, numerical measures, association and groups | [Open case](superstore/index.qmd) | On the Superstore page |

:::

Cases 1–6 draw on Berenson, Levine and Krehbiel's *Basic Business Statistics: Concepts and Applications*, ninth edition. Each identifies its source, observational unit and limits; Oxford uses reported summary inputs rather than raw box weights.
